kind: retrospective descriptive CG boss paint and wall-warning audit
diagnosticRepair: Preserved the first helper and failure log: it compared different CG graphics and Protocol.initBlock hash schemes before writing any output. The corrected read-only diagnostic verifies each scheme independently; no games, strategy or evaluation results changed.

definitions.earlyWindow: Zero-based turns 0..19. Only played turns contribute; report actual denominator for short games.
definitions.executionTimeMetadata: Raw per-game executionTimeMs player fields retained verbatim; no per-turn CPU inference or comparison with local wall-clock totals.
definitions.heightGroups: Descriptive height below18 versus18andabove, chosen from the prior investigation, not separate acceptance gates.
definitions.acceptedPaint: Rules.resolve PlayerMoves.cost; cells are PlayerMoves.count, with both actual simultaneous commands.
definitions.nominalCapacity: GameState.PAINT_PER_TURN per observed turn is an upper bound, not proof that affordable eligible moves existed.
definitions.mapIdentity: mapHash is SHA256 of exact CgReplay.globalGraphics UTF-8, matching boss_batch.MAP_SCHEME. coreMapHash independently hashes Protocol.initBlock(state,0); candidate/control pairs must match under both schemes.
definitions.warnings: Own stderr WARN turn N took Xms is matched by explicit N, never by frame index; delayed stderr is retained.

limitations: Read-only analysis of all40 new candidate games plus40 already completed cached controls. No tuning, retry or gate influence.
These boss games differ from the earlier V3 arena sample in maps/opponents and cannot measure a paired V6-vs-V3 improvement.
Cached control uses matching seeds/maps/seats but was played earlier and evolves different board states. Paint amount is not playing strength.
Under-spending or a self-reported wall warning does not identify an abort phase, missed legal move, or server timeout.
Absence of WARN is not proof of spare compute budget; the bot can stop cooperatively before the wrapper's warning threshold.
Replay markers are self-reported identity matching the retained artifact, not independent remote executed-source attestation.
Local V5/V6 ample-time speedup and actual CG paint/warnings are different measurements; no CG speedup percentage follows from them.
